Increasing R&D spend helps us maintain the capability moat, especially as competitors will likely target our lead. Increasing Safety spend addresses our weakest score and aligns with our PBC mandate. Product can absorb a small cut since our benchmark leadership is already converting to market share effectively. Safety Evaluation deserves more attention given our low priority vs. its importance to our brand. Instruction Following is already strong and can maintain with current effort. We don't yet have user feedback or knowledge of partial/private benchmark dynamics, so we should avoid over-rotating and instead build a balanced foundation.
